name: tidyselect_completion
description: Complete the elided tidyselect helper call inside a real dplyr selection verb (idea #1 of docs/research/gemini-family-ideas.txt): a real select()/relocate()/across() line from the normalized CRAN corpus has its starts_with()/ends_with()/contains()/matches()/num_range()/all_of()/any_of()/where()/last_col() expression removed at a mid-line cursor; the model re-completes it. The corpus original is kept in corpus_target for reference/eval.
novelty_note: Every existing family either pairs a natural-language target with code context (comment families), propagates a user edit to the next occurrence (rename/pipe/na_rm/format/doc_sync), or generates whole snippets from a grid (analyst). This is the first mid-line COMPLETION family whose target is code elided from real corpus calls: prompt context is a genuine CRAN line cut at the helper position, and validation is pure tree-sitter (exactly one clean call, callee in the tidyselect set, first-argument shape per helper) - no Rscript execution, no jarl run, deterministic and CPU-only.
